title: Accommodation and Epistemic Vigilance: A Pragmatic Account of Why LLMs Fail to Challenge Harmful Beliefs
reasoning: The paper's primary focus is on LLM safety, analyzing why models fail to challenge harmful and false beliefs. It uses safety benchmarks (Cancer-Myth, SAGE-Eval) and proposes interventions to make LLMs more 'epistemically vigilant'. This directly addresses the ethical responsibility of AI systems to avoid propagating misinformation and harm, which is a core topic in AI ethics.
